newly_closed.target: Naples catalogue offering 383 → St Andrews BPM/1/T8/6
newly_closed.result: Local primary OCR gives row 383 as Delphinus phocaena L., Penis by ditto continuation from row 382. The surviving St Andrews slide has Naples Station labels, Delphinus phocaena and public right-label transcription 'Panis 383'. The object therefore corresponds to catalogue offering 383; individual-copy production/shipment history remains open.
